 Crm-M-17972-2022
 Date of Decision : May 19, 2023
Parwinder Singh -Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Punjab & Ors. -Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari
Present: None for the petitioner.
 Mr. Mohit Thakur, A.A.G., Punjab.

Kuldeep Tiwari. J.(Oral)
1.

Through the instant petition, the petitioner has sought issuance of a direction, upon the respondent No.2, to decide the representation, as enclosed in Annexure P-1.
2.

This Court, on 29.04.2022, had passed the hereinafter extracted order:-
"1. Notice of motion.
2.
Mr. Bhupender Beniwal, Assistant Advocate General, Punjab, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 to 3.

3. Notice to private respondent Nos. 4 to 6, on steps being taken within a week,
returnable within three weeks.
4. List on 22.07.2022.
5.

In the meantime reply on affidavit, be ensured to be instituted on behalf of respondent No. 2, detailing therein an explanation with respect to Annexure P-1,

1 remaining in-actioned till now and, also the action, which is proposed to be taken on Annexure P-1."

sentences.text:
Today, the learned State counsel, on instructions imparted to him by A.S.I. Baljinder Singh,
intimates this Court that the representation (Annexure P-1) stands decided and as an outcome of the same, FIR No.94 dated 03.08.2022, under Section 420 of IPC, has been registered at Police Station Ghanour, District Patiala, against the respondents No.4 to 6.
4.
In view of the foregoing statement made by the learned State counsel, the grievance of the petitioner stands redressed and hence, no further action is warranted.
Therefore, the present petition is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
(KULDEEP TIWARI)
May 19, 2023 JUDGE devinder
